title: PairwiseEvalRecord
description: One line of pairwise_eval.jsonl. One record = one pair of memory entries that the system's consolidation step compared, plus the outcome of that comparison. This is the sole file Team B needs to compute FCR, MCR, the FCR-MCR frontier, and entity-clustering metrics.

record_id.description: Unique ID for this pairwise comparison within the run.

run_id.description: Foreign key into run_manifest.json. Groups records by strategy+backbone+seed+dataset_tier.

strategy.description: System/baseline that produced this decision. The stage-attribution configuration (A-D) and whether the DK-Mem gate was on are recorded in run_manifest.json (pipeline_config, dkmem_mode), not here.

threshold.description: Similarity threshold (tau) the system used as its merge cutoff for this decision. Recorded for provenance; Team B re-sweeps tau offline using similarity_score, so this need not match every tau in the frontier plot.

similarity_score.description: Raw sim(gloss_a, gloss_b) BEFORE any distinction gating is applied. Always reported, even when compatibility blocks the merge, so Team B can recompute merge(a,b) := similarity_score > tau at any tau without rerunning the system.

compatibility.description: Output of compatible(distinction_a, distinction_b). Null for runs with no distinction gating, i.e. DK-Mem off (dkmem_mode 'off' in run_manifest.json; e.g. plain mem0, flat-dense-rag, store-surface-only).

decision.description: The system's actual final action on this pair. 'supersede' = b is stored as replacing a (temporal update), not as a duplicate/co-reference. 'underdetermined_link' = neither merged nor discarded; entries kept separate and cross-referenced (DK-Mem's third branch).

superseded_entry_id.description: Only meaningful when decision == 'supersede': entry_id (a or b) that is now marked stale/replaced. Null otherwise.

predicted_entity_id.description: Declares that entry_a and entry_b belong to the same cluster as of THIS record. Required (non-null) when decision is 'merge' or 'supersede'; must be null otherwise. This is an edge, not a globally-authoritative final answer: because records are written incrementally, a later record elsewhere in the file can chain-merge entry_a or entry_b into a larger cluster without this record being rewritten. To get each entry's true final cluster, union-find over entry_id across every merge/supersede record in the run -- do not read this field from a single record in isolation.

entry_id.description: Stable ID for this stored memory entry (the write-stage output). Must be stable across a run so it can be joined against upstream probe metadata if needed.

source_utterance_id.description: ID of the input utterance/turn this entry was extracted from, as assigned by Team B's dataset (Tier 1/2/3). Passthrough only.

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the source utterance, e.g. 'hi', 'en', 'hi-Latn' for romanized Hinglish, 'de', 'ja', 'tr'.

surface.description: Verbatim original-language text the entry was extracted from. Null only for strategies that discard it (e.g. store-surface-only after the point it collapses to gloss -- should normally still be populated).

gloss.description: Normalized English retrieval key produced by the write stage. This is the field similarity_score is computed over.

distinction.description: Source-language discriminative feature extracted at write time. Null if the strategy has no distinction extraction, or if the lexicon found no discriminative marker in this utterance.

class.description: Which in-scope distinction class this marker belongs to (kinship primary; honorific_register and name_variant secondary).

script.description: Script the marker was observed in, e.g. 'deva', 'latn'. Optional.

extraction_method.description: Which stage of the write-side cascade produced this distinction value.

gold_entity_id.description: Ground-truth entity ID for this entry, as assigned by Team B in the probe/eval dataset. Team A must pass this straight through from input to output unchanged; Team A never computes it.
